# Bitcoin Circular

> The world's first intelligence platform for Bitcoin circular economies — communities where Bitcoin is earned and spent locally, creating a self-sustaining loop.

Bitcoin Circular tracks and measures Bitcoin circular economies worldwide. It combines BTCMap merchant data, Blink wallet read-only transaction data, and the FBCE 5-tier framework to compute a transparent Circularity Score (0–100) for each economy across five pillars: Merchant Saturation, Retention, Earner Penetration, Transaction Velocity, and Growth Momentum.

The platform is privacy-first and non-custodial. Wallet addresses, payment hashes, and real names are never stored. Validation uses a 2-of-3 community-validator consensus model.

- [Register an Economy](/register): Add a new Bitcoin circular economy to the platform.
